name: Doodle Bluff
description: Draw a classmate's strange phrase, then write fake titles for each drawing and hunt for the real one. Fool the class to score.

intro.message:
DOODLE BLUFF!

First, write a strange phrase. Next, draw the phrase you get handed. Then, round by round: invent a fake title for each drawing and vote for the real one.

100 points for spotting the truth. 50 for every classmate your fake fools.

phrases.prompt: Write a short, strange phrase that would be fun to watch someone draw. Example: a nervous volcano on its first day of school.

draw.prompt:
Draw this: {{phrases.assigned}}

No letters or numbers in your drawing!

check.template: Review the drawings below, then start the rounds. One bad drawing? Hide it from the moderation list. 'Try again' restarts the drawing round for everyone.

titles.prompt: What is the REAL title of this drawing? Make up a fake so convincing your classmates pick it.

end.message: That's Doodle Bluff! 100 for spotting the truth, 50 per classmate fooled. Run it again, the phrases only get weirder.

recommendedFor: Icebreakers, reward days, and any class that loved Draw Gallery. The artist sits out their own round, so nobody can rig their own drawing.
